derivedFrom: hypercar.glb (Meshy text-to-3d, see hypercar.meta.json and hypercar.remesh.meta.json)
change: geometry untouched; baked base-colour and metallic-roughness textures replaced by flat PBR materials split by region (body, glass, tyre, rim, headlight, taillight, underbody) because the baked glass and interior read as see-through. The baked mesh is a double shell, so glass and light regions only apply to outward-facing triangles (inner-shell fragments take the body colour), the underside is a dark body blue, and the paint carries a subtle vertical COLOR_0 gradient. The plates leave gaps, so a small solid core loft (two primitives, 468 triangles) sits behind them: body paint, and dark glass under the cabin.
